meta.note: Everything here is web-only and deliberately absent from tokens/core.tokens.json: CSS font stacks, breakpoints in px, ch/rem measures, and the serialisation of structured shadows to box-shadow. A native consumer never reads this file.

unitPolicy.note: Core dimensions are logical px. Text-relative groups become rem so a user's root font size still scales them; geometry stays in px because a hairline or a corner radius should not grow with text size.

fontFamily.system-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fontFamily.system-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
